fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics' price targets have widened significantly from KRW 270,000 (BNK Investment) to KRW 670,000 (Nomura Securities), with the stock hitting KRW 179,200 intraday on November 6 before bouncing to KRW 208,000 on November 12.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 revenue was KRW 195.2532 trillion (YoY +126.9%), operating profit was KRW 107.4405 trillion (+783.1%), marking four consecutive quarters of record results, with the semiconductor division accounting for 99% of total profit.
